curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how alcohol and drugs affect driving, the any-drug rule, the underage zero alcohol limit, controlled substances, marijuana, and medicine labels.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards per rule; contrast cards for the alcohol limit versus controlled substances and legal medicine versus legal to drive.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver and asking whether driving is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach safe rides home and that only time sobers you, then the implied consent law, the PAC test and the penalties for refusing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for breath versus blood test and refusal consequences.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on implied consent and PAC test refusal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover concentration, headphones and radio, phone rules by license type, reading and eating, pets and window clutter.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each distraction rule; contrast cards for headphones versus radio and permit versus regular license phone rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a distraction and asking what the handbook says.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define drowsy driving and its causes, the higher teen risk, and the warning signs that mean pull over and rest.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each drowsy driving fact; contrast cards for causes and warning signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a tired driver and asking what to do.
